d: An anthropomorphic lion with platinum white facial hair and a thick, long mane of the same shade, paired with sharp, glowing crimson eyes. The face appears mature and stern, set into a powerfully built, muscular physique. The attire consists of a deep crimson and burgundy ornate cape with gold accents, paired with a white and gold ceremonial waist-wrap and heavy golden armor plating on the shoulders and hips. Notable features include two long, black, curved horns protruding from the head, white fur on the upper body with red tribal markings, and dark brown fur on the lower legs. BODY COLOR: White and dark brown LEGS: Digitigrade with large paws
